name: Shanghai Ruking Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Ruking Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of various products in the power electronics and motor control industries in China. The company offers industrial automation products, such as SEB3, HERO2; and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning and refrigeration equipment, RD4 1-phase inverters and 3-phase inverters. It also provides automotive thermal management, including e-compressor controller, PTC drive, system controller, and DCDC converter.
